svg.title: Five Recovery Lanes and Their Operator Fee Math
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-recovery-lane-fee-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Recovery Lanes and Their Operator Fee Math; subtitle: Illustrative contract yields, not measured niche performance; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: The first four bars each assume $100,000 of independently verified, realized client recovery and a permitted expense contingency rate. The fifth assumes 120 completed WOTC administrative packages at a fixed $250 fee. Denominators differ deliberately; bars are fee-dollar examples, not a ranking of expected return or a Base revenue decomposition.; caption: Parcel $50,000; utility $35,000; waste and telecom $30,000; property assessment $25,000; WOTC processing $30,000. Client recoveries and tax-credit amounts remain outside operator revenue.; stages: label: Parcel service and billing recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 50%; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Earn $50,000 only where the signed agreement supports a 50% share and the carrier accepts the underlying claim. Check FedEx or UPS guarantee availability, waivers, eligible services, submission windows, and API terms before automation.; label: Commercial utility tariff recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 35%; numeric value: 35000.0; detail: Earn $35,000 on documented recoveries from applicable rate classifications, meter errors, or eligible sewer deductions. Match cooling-tower meter evidence to local rules and distinguish slow refund issuance from an approved adjustment.; label: Waste and telecom billing recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 30%; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Earn $30,000 from supported duplicate charges, disconnected services, or contractual rate errors. Separate refunded historical charges from future savings, and prevent the same correction from generating two overlapping fee claims.; label: Property assessment recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 25%; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: Earn $25,000 only under a permitted engagement handled by appropriately credentialed personnel. Track protest and payment deadlines independently; a reduced assessment does not itself establish a received cash refund.; label: WOTC administrative processing; value: 120 completed packages multiplied by $250; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Earn $30,000 from separately scoped administrative deliverables, not a percentage of federal tax credits. Verify hire-date statutory coverage and Form 8850 timing. Fixed pricing does not remove practitioner, privacy, or substantiation requirements.

text.title: Five Recovery Lanes and Their Operator Fee Math
text.tspan: Five Recovery Lanes and Their Operator Fee Math

rect.title: label: Parcel service and billing recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 50%; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: Earn $50,000 only where the signed agreement supports a 50% share and the carrier accepts the underlying claim. Check FedEx or UPS guarantee availability, waivers, eligible services, submission windows, and API terms before automation.

label: Commercial utility tariff recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 35%; numeric value: 35000.0; detail: Earn $35,000 on documented recoveries from applicable rate classifications, meter errors, or eligible sewer deductions. Match cooling-tower meter evidence to local rules and distinguish slow refund issuance from an approved adjustment.

label: Waste and telecom billing recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 30%; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Earn $30,000 from supported duplicate charges, disconnected services, or contractual rate errors. Separate refunded historical charges from future savings, and prevent the same correction from generating two overlapping fee claims.

label: Property assessment recoveries; value: $100,000 realized recovery multiplied by 25%; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: Earn $25,000 only under a permitted engagement handled by appropriately credentialed personnel. Track protest and payment deadlines independently; a reduced assessment does not itself establish a received cash refund.

label: WOTC administrative processing; value: 120 completed packages multiplied by $250; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Earn $30,000 from separately scoped administrative deliverables, not a percentage of federal tax credits. Verify hire-date statutory coverage and Form 8850 timing. Fixed pricing does not remove practitioner, privacy, or substantiation requirements.

text.title: Assumptions: The first four bars each assume $100,000 of independently verified, realized client recovery and a permitted expense contingency rate. The fifth assumes 120 completed WOTC administrative packages at a fixed $250 fee. Denominators differ deliberately; bars are fee-dollar examples, not a ranking of expected return or a Base revenue decomposition.
